<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 360" width="640" height="360">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="hcSky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#04080c"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#071018"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0b1a20"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="hcChrome" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#eaf6f4"/>
      <stop offset="38%" stop-color="#8fb9b6"/>
      <stop offset="52%" stop-color="#dff3f0"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#5e8a89"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="hcIris" cx="50%" cy="45%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#bff7ee"/>
      <stop offset="45%" stop-color="#2fb8a8"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#063b3a"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="hcGlow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#2fb8a8" stop-opacity="0.45"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2fb8a8" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <clipPath id="hcEyeClip">
      <path d="M182 150 Q320 66 458 150 Q320 234 182 150 Z"/>
    </clipPath>
  </defs>

  <rect width="640" height="360" fill="url(#hcSky)"/>
  <circle cx="320" cy="150" r="150" fill="url(#hcGlow)"/>

  <!-- the seal ring -->
  <circle cx="320" cy="150" r="122" fill="none" stroke="url(#hcChrome)" stroke-width="3"/>
  <circle cx="320" cy="150" r="113" fill="none" stroke="#2fb8a8" stroke-width="1" stroke-opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- skyline inside the lower lid -->
  <g clip-path="url(#hcEyeClip)">
    <rect x="182" y="150" width="276" height="90" fill="#050d11"/>
    <g fill="#0e2b30">
      <rect x="196" y="176" width="22" height="64"/>
      <rect x="224" y="160" width="16" height="80"/>
      <rect x="246" y="186" width="26" height="54"/>
      <rect x="278" y="152" width="18" height="88"/>
      <rect x="302" y="170" width="30" height="70"/>
      <rect x="338" y="158" width="14" height="82"/>
      <rect x="358" y="180" width="24" height="60"/>
      <rect x="388" y="164" width="18" height="76"/>
      <rect x="412" y="188" width="28" height="52"/>
    </g>
    <g fill="#2fb8a8" fill-opacity="0.65">
      <rect x="202" y="184" width="4" height="4"/><rect x="210" y="196" width="4" height="4"/>
      <rect x="228" y="168" width="4" height="4"/><rect x="230" y="188" width="4" height="4"/>
      <rect x="252" y="194" width="4" height="4"/><rect x="262" y="206" width="4" height="4"/>
      <rect x="282" y="160" width="4" height="4"/><rect x="286" y="182" width="4" height="4"/>
      <rect x="310" y="178" width="4" height="4"/><rect x="322" y="198" width="4" height="4"/>
      <rect x="342" y="166" width="4" height="4"/><rect x="344" y="190" width="4" height="4"/>
      <rect x="364" y="188" width="4" height="4"/><rect x="374" y="204" width="4" height="4"/>
      <rect x="392" y="172" width="4" height="4"/><rect x="396" y="194" width="4" height="4"/>
      <rect x="418" y="196" width="4" height="4"/><rect x="430" y="208" width="4" height="4"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- iris + pupil -->
  <circle cx="320" cy="146" r="42" fill="url(#hcIris)"/>
  <circle cx="320" cy="146" r="42" fill="none" stroke="#eaf6f4" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="320" cy="146" r="15" fill="#02100f"/>
  <circle cx="308" cy="134" r="6" fill="#eaf6f4" fill-opacity="0.85"/>
  <g stroke="#0a5c55" stroke-width="1" stroke-opacity="0.8">
    <path d="M320 106 L320 122"/><path d="M320 170 L320 186"/>
    <path d="M280 146 L296 146"/><path d="M344 146 L360 146"/>
    <path d="M292 118 L303 129"/><path d="M337 163 L348 174"/>
    <path d="M348 118 L337 129"/><path d="M303 163 L292 174"/>
  </g>

  <!-- eyelids -->
  <path d="M182 150 Q320 66 458 150" fill="none" stroke="url(#hcChrome)" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M182 150 Q320 234 458 150" fill="none" stroke="url(#hcChrome)" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- wordmark -->
  <text x="320" y="300" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif" font-size="46" font-weight="300" letter-spacing="16" fill="url(#hcChrome)">HALCYON</text>
  <text x="320" y="330" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="10" fill="#2fb8a8">R E - Y O U</text>
  <text x="320" y="352" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif" font-size="11" letter-spacing="3" fill="#5e8a89">WHEN THE FIRST TIME WASN'T GOOD ENOUGH</text>
</svg>
